headline: UK Immigration Curbs Threaten £15 Billion Adult Social Care Industry
summary: Tighter UK immigration policies risk exacerbating staffing deficits across the country's £15 billion care sector, creating operational pressures for private and public care providers.
why: The UK adult social care sector is a major employer whose labour constraints affect public health spending and overall fiscal budgets.

impacts.name: UK Healthcare Providers
impacts.why: Stricter immigration rules limit recruitment of overseas staff, driving up wage expenses and staffing shortages.
